## Constants

CHARSET   = "qpzry9x8gf2tvdw0s3jn54khce6mua7l"
GENERATOR = [0x3b6a57b2, 0x26508e6d, 0x1ea119fa, 0x3d4233dd, 0x2a1462b3]

## bech32_polymod(values) -> int
chk = 1; for v: b = chk >> 25; chk = ((chk & 0x1ffffff) << 5) ^ v;
for i in 0..4: if (b >> i) & 1: chk ^= GENERATOR[i]. return chk.
All intermediates fit in 30 bits -> plain JS `^ << >> &` are exact.

## bech32_hrp_expand(hrp) -> [ord>>5 for each] + [0] + [ord&31 for each]

## bech32_verify_checksum(hrp, data) -> polymod(hrp_expand(hrp) + data) === 1

## bech32_decode(bech) -> [hrp, data] or [null, null]
1. if any code point < 33 or > 126  -> [null, null]
2. if (lower(bech) !== bech AND upper(bech) !== bech) -> [null, null]   # mixed case
   (both conditions live in one `or`; step 1 short-circuits first, same result)
3. bech = lower(bech)
4. pos = last index of '1'
5. if pos < 1 OR pos + 7 > len(bech) OR **pos > 83** -> [null, null]
   *** There is NO 90-character total-length check. The only length limit is
   HRP length <= 83 (pos == len(hrp)). Verified by bisection:
     hrp 83 + 11 data chars (total  95) -> OK      hrp 84 + 11 (total  96) -> FAIL
     hrp 24 + 71 data chars (total  96) -> OK      (so total 96 is fine)
     hrp 83 + 71 data chars (total 155) -> OK      hrp 84 + 71 (total 156) -> FAIL
   Max reachable total for a valid segwit address is 83 + 1 + 71 = 155, and it passes.
6. if any char of bech[pos+1:] not in CHARSET -> [null, null]
7. data = CHARSET index of each char of bech[pos+1:]
8. if not verify_checksum(hrp, data) -> [null, null]
9. return [hrp, data[:-6]]

## convertbits(data, frombits, tobits, pad=true) -> array | null
acc=0; bits=0; ret=[]; maxv=(1<<tobits)-1; max_acc=(1<<(frombits+tobits-1))-1
for v in data:
  if v < 0 or (v >> frombits): return null
  acc = ((acc << frombits) | v) & max_acc; bits += frombits
  while bits >= tobits: bits -= tobits; ret.push((acc >> bits) & maxv)
if pad: if bits: ret.push((acc << (tobits - bits)) & maxv)
else if bits >= frombits or ((acc << (frombits - tobits)) & maxv): return null
return ret

## segwit decode(hrp, addr) -> [witver, witprog] or [null, null]

if data[0] > 16: return [null, null]
